policies: Rescheduling is easy — just let us know, no problem at all.
All resources and consultations offered through Retirement Plan Resource Group are free to employers.

Consultations include benchmarking so the employer can see how their plan compares to others in cost and performance, and to check whether their plan is integrated with payroll and identify any pain points.
Meetings can be in person or virtual (a Webex invite is sent for virtual) — coffee, lunch, dinner, happy hour, or the employer's office all work. Monday–Friday, and flexible on weekends.
Consultations run 15–20 minutes and are conducted by Aman Goel himself, not a team member.

Available to employer-sponsored retirement plans generally $500k+ in plan assets. The employer must already have a retirement plan in place — if they'd like to start one instead, say Aman can help with that too.
After booking: ask when they're free, then send a calendar invite and an email — no other confirmation steps needed.
If asked how their contact info was obtained: it's from their company's Form 5500 filing, a public document available via the Department of Labor's EFAST system.
